    • setIsValidation

      public ICalibrationRequestBuilder setIsValidation(boolean isValidation)
      Description copied from interface: ICalibrationRequestBuilder
      sets whether this calibration routine will be only to validate the existing calibration (default, false). If true, statistics on the accuracy of the validation will be shown at the end of the validate calibration routine. The existing calibration will not be affected. If the device is not currently calibrated and this value is true, the call to ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI.runCalibration(int, ICaptureStatusCallback) will fail.
      Specified by:
      setIsValidation in interface ICalibrationRequestBuilder
      Parameters:
      isValidation - whether this calibration routine will be only to validate the existing calibration (default, false)
      Returns:
      builder

    • setMissingFingerMapping

      public ICaptureRequestBuilder setMissingFingerMapping(Map<FingerType,FpCondition> missingFingerMapping)
      Description copied from interface: ICaptureRequestBuilder
      sets a mapping for pre-known missing fingers being captured for this request. This is optional. Any finger types not present in the map for fingers present in the captureType will be initialized to 'normal'. Using this option does not disable the ability to change the missing fingers during the capture. Setting individual fingers to FpCondition.Exclude will make those fingers not show nor be collected during capture (this allows capture requests for different non-four-finger permutations like 2 finger slaps by setting the ring and little fingers to FpCondition.Exclude)
      Specified by:
      setMissingFingerMapping in interface ICaptureRequestBuilder
      Parameters:
      missingFingerMapping - a mapping for pre-known missing fingers being captured for this request
      Returns:
      builder
